scope: Three fixed previously consumed development pairs; public NLUT pretrained weights adapted through disclosed published-code compatibility. Not general NLUT failure or a new held-out evaluation.
review_method: Unblinded autonomous developer review: all three four-arm strips, all twelve individual 1600px encoded-source-size arms, and all three references inspected. No population preference, camera-native 12-24MP, face/text coverage or universal safety claim.

rows.subject: Snowy garden through window with flags
rows.reason: Adaptation introduces cyan/yellow islands and posterized contours in window, walls and awning, with amplified colored noise. Pretrained is dull and green-grey, not a clear photographic gain.

rows.subject: Fruit and colored blocks against white foam
rows.reason: Adapted white foam becomes dark-green islands and solarized contours; fruit has false-color patching and dark outlines. Pretrained already has new color contours and unnatural foam/fruit color separation, though milder.

rows.subject: White daisies and green leaves
rows.reason: Adapted leaves, soil and defocused flowers acquire stepped color islands/outlines and petals lose delicate tonal gradation. Both learned arms wash out flower colors without a compelling photographic gain.

post_result_diagnostics.scope: Read-only CPU diagnostics after visual failure; no new acceptance gates, training or photo rendering. Cell-origin forward differences on residual LUT plus identity with spacing 1/32; not an integrated fold-volume estimate or proof of sole causality.

synthetic_full_2048_basis_original_vs_fu.input: seed20260907, linspace(0,1,3*256*256), two identical batch rows, reference flipped horizontally; pretrained eval mode, CPU float32, four threads
synthetic_full_2048_basis_original_vs_fu.interpretation: Measured reassociation error is small on this synthetic forward, not a training-trajectory or official CUDA parity certificate. No gross reconstruction mismatch observed.

post_result_diagnostics.interpretation: Extracted composite LUTs contain local orientation reversals and steep responses consistent with observed solarization/noise amplification. Basis-wise smoothness does not itself certify the predicted weighted composite. This is not a causal ablation.
